summary: MO-006 YouTube Publisher™, MO-007 Universal Distribution Framework™, and MO-008 Governance Binding Layer™ verified end-to-end. Backend: 14/14 pytest cases pass in /app/backend/tests/test_iteration34_distribution_governance.py — (a) GET /api/distribution/connectors returns exactly 7 connectors {qru_store, youtube, wordpress, google_drive, email, etsy, amazon_kdp} with qru_store connected=True/can_distribute=True/native=True and the five stubs {wordpress, google_drive, email, etsy, amazon_kdp} returning connected=False/can_distribute=False with an honest reason string; (b) POST /api/distribution/distribute with [qru_store:public, youtube:private] returns distributed=1, needs_setup=1, the QRU Store target status='delivered' with external_id == product_id and detail='Listed in QRU Store™...' — the YouTube target honestly returns status='needs_setup' (no video file) without erroring; (c) GET /api/distribution/jobs?product_id=... contains the delivered job; POST /jobs/{id}/verify returns verified=true and external_id==product_id; GET /jobs/{id}/analytics returns supported=true with metrics.purchases (int) and metrics.revenue_usd; (d) GET /api/youtube/status is well-formed with connected/can_upload flags + account name; (e) GET /api/qiks/standards contains ≥15 Founder documents; KR Master Specification, Methodology Manual, and Factory Operations Blueprint each expose verbatim document_content, source_document, and classification via GET /api/qiks/standards/{id}; (f) GET /api/governance-binding/overview returns priority_bound=5/5, agents=8, manufacturing_stages=7, loop starting with 'Standards' and ending with 'Published Products', and all 5 enforcement-priority standards adopted with real standard_ids; (g) GET /api/governance-binding/agents returns exactly 8 agents each bound to an adopted standard with a standard_id; (h) GET /api/governance-binding/manufacturing/{order_id}/compliance returns 7 governed stages (all status='Governed', all governing_standard.adopted=true) plus the Methodology Manual pipeline_standard adopted. Frontend Playwright end-to-end verified on the public preview URL: Founder login succeeded; /distribution — 7 connector cards render with correct data-testids, qru_store & youtube are clickable while wordpress/google_drive/email/etsy/amazon_kdp are correctly disabled; selecting QRU Store (public) + product 'PRD-00180' and clicking dist-distribute created a job that appeared in the Distribution Jobs table with verify-{id} + analytics-{id} action buttons active — clicking both worked without error; /youtube — Connected as Founder channel with StatusChip 'Ready to Publish', full composer (yt-product, yt-title, yt-description, yt-tags, yt-privacy default='private', yt-playlist, yt-video-file, yt-publish) renders, and yt-publish is disabled=true when no MP4 is chosen (guard enforced); /qiks — 31 standards cards render, search 'KR Master' isolates it, opening the card opens std-dialog with the std-document verbatim panel visible; /agents — governance-loop strip, agent-registry (8 rows, 9 counting the shared 'agent-' prefix registry container), stage-bindings, design-governance all visible; selecting an order in chain-order renders 7 governance stages in the compliance-record; /mfg-command shows mfg-governed-by; /kr2 shows kr2-governed-by; nav-distribution / nav-youtube / nav-agents all visible in the sidebar. No functional defects; only minor a11y warning (DialogContent missing aria-describedby) observed.

issues: DialogContent (shadcn) is missing an accessible Description / aria-describedby — Radix logs a11y warning to console. Consider adding a <DialogDescription> for screen-reader parity.

Multiple 'In HTML, <span> cannot be a child of <option>' hydration errors seen on /distribution, /youtube, /qiks, /agents, /kr2. Emitted by the Emergent visual-editor tooling wrapping every <option>'s text in a <span data-ve-dynamic='true'>. NOT a real app bug (the code writes plain text in options), but suppresses cleanly only if visual-editor overlay is disabled or the wrapper is limited to non-<option> elements.

critical_code_review_comments: distribution/engines._run_job(): when connector.distribute() raises (except-branch), `res` is set to None but `res.detail` is later referenced in the final else-clause via `(res.detail if res else err)` — currently safe due to the `res if res else err` guard, but the flow relies on res==None as sentinel; consider always returning a DistributionResult(ok=False, ...) from connectors and dropping the try/except-to-None dance for clarity.

distribution/engines.distribute(): serially awaits _run_job(job['id']) per target. For a Founder distributing to N connectors, this blocks the API call for N * (external-API latency). Consider asyncio.gather() with per-connector timeouts, or return-then-run-async and let clients poll /jobs — especially important once real YouTube publish uploads (multi-minute) come online.

distribution/connectors.QRUStoreConnector.distribute(): unconditionally sets `status: 'Published'`/`store_listed: True` on the product without checking the caller's authority beyond the router's require_super_admin. Fine today (only Founder distributes), but as roles expand, gate on the connector too (e.g., product_state != 'Approved' → NEEDS_SETUP).

governance_binding._standard_index(): reads all standards on every governance API call. Cache by mtime (or in-process TTL) — currently every /agents, /overview, /design, /compliance re-fetches the full standards collection.

FactoryAgents.js ManufacturingChain: the compliance-record stages are rendered as .grid.grid-cols-1 divs — no explicit data-testid on each stage row. Recommend data-testid=`compliance-stage-{i}` for future stage-level assertions.

InstitutionalKnowledge.js std-dialog: DialogContent lacks a DialogDescription (Radix warning). Add <DialogDescription>{open.description}</DialogDescription> under DialogTitle to fix the a11y warning without affecting layout.

YouTubePublisher.js: publish button label is always 'Publish to YouTube' — when busy && progress>0 it stays the same text but shows spinner. Consider showing 'Uploading to QRU… {progress}%' or 'Publishing to YouTube…' to distinguish the two-phase upload for Founders.
DistributionCenter.js: verify/analytics/retry action icons have title attributes but no visible text/label; add sr-only labels for a11y (e.g., Verify job).
